faqs.q: How much is an emergency appointment?
faqs.a: Same-day emergency appointments are £50 for the consultation plus £10 for any X-rays, with treatment charged on top.
Yes. The team is used to nervous patients and people who haven't seen a dentist in a long time, and will go at your pace.

faqs.q: Is the Upperton Road practice open on Saturday?
faqs.a: On Saturdays Upperton Road is phone lines only, 9am to 12pm; Saturday patients are seen at Uppingham Road.
Parking details aren't in my notes, so the practice team will confirm the best place to park.

emergency.message: We can offer a same-day emergency appointment. The consultation is £50, plus £10 for any X-rays, and treatment is charged on top. We aim to get you pain free at the appointment.
emergency.severeAdvice: If you have severe swelling affecting breathing or swallowing, call 999 or go to A&E.
